items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: I know Dr. Nicemonder (PHONETIC), she's head of the Rehabilitation Methadone Program, and she explained it very simply that addiction to hard drugs is a matter of accessibility.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's the reputation we have. And the stigma is still there.

Yeah. I heard somebody saying, 'Pardon me for saying this, but why is it musicians,' -- this was a doctor operating on my toe, 'why is it musicians are such addicts, addicted to heroin?' I said, 'Well, I know Dr. Nicemonder (PHONETIC), she's head of the Rehabilitation Methadone Program, and she explained it very simply that addiction to hard drugs is a matter of accessibility.' And I said, 'I'll tell you what she also said; that the largest number of addicts is doctors, Doctor, not musicians.'
